Ribbon cables for the need of enthusiasts and games

Powerful +12V Single Rail for your VGA

+12V single rail power supply is that you will be able to feed more alternating current, specially VGA card need stable intensity to work ,HYDRO GD series offer full power individually, eliminating the limitations and avoid any overloading conditions.

Hydro GD series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and as a result to reduce lots of electricity cost.
For DIY enthusiasts and gamers,customize your power supply by three kinds of changeable side stickers to match the color scheme of your internal components.
Stable DC to DC Output Quality

HYDRO GD series apply DC to DC modules to improve the reliability and greater compatibility with the quality with low ripple noise to reduce interference of system components, and prolong system lifetime.
Facilitate system installation, reduce cable clutter and enhance internal airflow and cooling performance.
Get the most reliability and greatest performance with the use of the highest quality Japan-made electrolytic capacitors for more safety.
